lines.serbian: Luka i Jana žele da skuvaju večeru.
lines.croatian: Luka i Jana žele skuhati večeru.
lines.english: Luka and Jana want to cook dinner.

lines.serbian: Idu u prodavnicu sa spiskom: špageti, jaja, slanina i sir.
lines.croatian: Idu u trgovinu s popisom: špageti, jaja, slanina i sir.
lines.english: They go to the shop with a list: spaghetti, eggs, bacon and cheese.

lines.serbian: – Treba nam i pavlaka – kaže Luka.
lines.croatian: – Treba nam i vrhnje – kaže Luka.

lines.serbian: – Šta? Ne! U karbonari nema pavlake!
lines.croatian: – Što? Ne! U karbonari nema vrhnja!
lines.english: "What? No! There's no cream in carbonara!"

lines.serbian: Starija gospođa pored njih ih gleda.
lines.croatian: Starija gospođa pored njih ih gleda.
lines.english: An older lady next to them is looking at them.

lines.serbian: – Mladi ljudi, ja sam iz Rima.
lines.croatian: – Mladi ljudi, ja sam iz Rima.

lines.serbian: – Jaja, sir, slanina, biber. Bez pavlake!
lines.croatian: – Jaja, sir, slanina, papar. Bez vrhnja!

lines.english: Jana looks at Luka. She has won.
Luka puts the cream back on the shelf.

lines.serbian: Kod kuće Luka seče slaninu, a Jana meša jaja sa sirom.
lines.croatian: Kod kuće Luka reže slaninu, a Jana miješa jaja sa sirom.
lines.english: At home Luka cuts the bacon, and Jana mixes the eggs with the cheese.
The spaghetti cooks for ten minutes.

lines.serbian: – Priznaj, bolje je bez pavlake – kaže Jana.
lines.croatian: – Priznaj, bolje je bez vrhnja – kaže Jana.
lines.english: "Admit it, it's better without cream," says Jana.

lines.serbian: – Dobro. Ali nemoj to da kažeš mojoj mami.
lines.croatian: – Dobro. Ali nemoj to reći mojoj mami.
